description: This file defines API routes for file management within a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for listing, uploading, and deleting files associated with user sessions, with integration to Supabase storage and database. The code implements access control, file validation, and storage interaction logic.

methods.name: Client get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client using environment variables for configuration.

methods.name: str _ext(name: str)
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename, returning it in lowercase.
